title: merge.sh and main-health.sh
acceptance: merge.sh acquires the merge lock, rebases the branch onto main, re-runs verify.sh, squash-merges, pushes, and releases the lock on every exit path
A failed post-rebase verify aborts the merge and returns the task to the implementer rather than merging
When config auto_merge is false, merge.sh opens a PR with the diff, verify output, and review verdict instead of merging
main-health.sh runs verify.sh against a clean checkout of main and reports a single exit code
Locks are atomic, record a pid, and are reclaimable after a configurable stale timeout

history.detail: merge lock, rebase, post-rebase re-verify, PR path when auto_merge is off; health cached by main SHA
